Manage delegated identities (experimental)

Aliases:

* identity

## Usage

```console
coder identities
```

## Description

```console
A delegated identity is an identity for something that acts under you, for example a coding agent. It owns the workspaces created on its behalf, is named in audit logs, and can never do more than you.
  - Create an identity that may only read its own workspaces:

     $ coder identities create my-agent --scope workspace:read

  - Create a workspace on its behalf:

     $ coder create my-agent/task-1 --template docker

  - Change what it may do:

     $ coder identities update my-agent --scope workspace:read --scope template:read
```

## Subcommands

| Name                               | Purpose                                             |
|------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| [<code>create</code>](./create.md) | Create a delegated identity under you               |
| [<code>list</code>](./list.md)     | List the delegated identities below you             |
| [<code>show</code>](./show.md)     | Show a delegated identity                           |
| [<code>update</code>](./update.md) | Replace what a delegated identity may do            |
| [<code>delete</code>](./delete.md) | Delete a delegated identity that owns no workspaces |
